## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 分区过滤（全表扫描必须带）
WHERE grass_date = date '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region in (${grass_region})

-- 小时过滤（INSERT 写入用）
WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_DT}'
  AND hour = '${BIZ_H}'

-- 按天数最近分区
WHERE grass_date = date '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = 'SG'

-- App 版本过滤（新版本逻辑）
WHERE app_version >= '3.45.0'
  AND rn_version >= '6.54.0'

-- 直播场景版本过滤
WHERE rn_version_format >= '6061011'
  AND app_version_format >= '35200'

-- iOS 特殊逻辑
WHERE platform_desc = 'ios_app'
  AND app_version_format >= '35300'

-- 入口过滤
WHERE entrance in (27, 28, 37, 38, 39, 42, 48)  -- 直播
WHERE entrance in (29, 33, 34, 35, 50, 54, 55, 56, 58)  -- 视频
WHERE entrance in ('4')  -- YMAL PDP

-- 去重过滤（排除客户端延迟上报）
WHERE rn = 1  -- 基于 row_number() over (partition by session_id, sequence_id order by log_timestamp desc)

-- 广告流量过滤
WHERE ads_id > 0
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN 旧版追踪表 (UBT) — 对比新旧追踪数据
-- JOIN key: unique_id + grass_date + entrance + grass_region
FROM old_tracking
INNER JOIN tms_dedup_table
    ON old_tracking.unique_id = tms_tracking.unique_id
   AND old_tracking.grass_date = tms_tracking.grass_date
   AND old_tracking.entrance = tms_tracking.entrance
   AND old_tracking.grass_region = tms_tracking.grass_region

-- JOIN 旧版追踪 item 表 — 按广告维度对比
FROM tms_table t1
LEFT JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live t2
    ON t1.ads_id = t2.ads_id
   AND t1.request_id = t2.ads_request_id
   AND t1.placement = t2.ads_placement
   AND t1.entrance = t2.ads_entrance

-- 自引用去重 (CTE)
-- WITH dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, sequence_id ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC) rn FROM ...)
-- WHERE rn = 1
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 按入口+操作聚合（TMS 与旧版差异对比）
SELECT
    entrance,
    ads_operation,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old.field <=> new.field, 0, 1)) AS unequal_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old.field <=> new.field, 0, 1)) * 1.0000 / COUNT(*) AS unequal_rate
GROUP BY entrance, grass_region, grass_date

-- 按操作/入口交叉对比（数据质量验证）
SELECT
    operation AS operation_new,
    entrance AS entrance_new,
    operation AS operation_old,
    ads_entrance AS entrance_old,
    COUNT(*) AS num,
    SUM(if(t1.unique_id != t2.unique_id, 1, 0)) AS unique_id_not_equal,
    SUM(if(t1.unique_id != t2.unique_id, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS rate
GROUP BY operation, entrance, ads_entrance
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: TMS vs UBT 字段级差异对比 (Livestream)

```sql
WITH ubt_day_dup AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN entrance = 1 THEN 'GLOBAL SEARCH'
             WHEN entrance = 4 THEN 'YMAL PDP'
             WHEN entrance = 27 THEN 'LIVE STREAM DISCOVERY'
             WHEN entrance = 28 THEN 'LIVE STREAM FOR YOU'
             WHEN entrance = 37 THEN 'LS HOME CAROUSEL'
             WHEN entrance = 38 THEN 'LS PDP'
             WHEN entrance = 39 THEN 'LS AUTO LANDING'
             WHEN entrance = 42 THEN 'LS VIDEO FEED'
             WHEN entrance = 48 THEN 'LS GAME'
        END AS scence
    FROM (
        SELECT *,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, sequence_id ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC) rn
        FROM dev_mp_paidads.dwd_tracking_tms_request_event_hi__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_date = date '${grass_date}'
          AND grass_region in (${grass_region})
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN old.entrance = 27 THEN 'LIVE STREAM DISCOVERY'
         WHEN old.entrance = 28 THEN 'LIVE STREAM FOR YOU'
         WHEN old.entrance = 37 THEN 'LS HOME CAROUSEL'
         WHEN old.entrance = 38 THEN 'LS PDP'
         WHEN old.entrance = 39 THEN 'LS AUTO LANDING'
         WHEN old.entrance = 42 THEN 'LS VIDEO FEED'
         WHEN old.entrance = 48 THEN 'LS GAME'
    END AS scence,
    old.entrance,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old.user_id <=> tms.user_id, 0, 1)) AS unequal_user_id_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old.user_id <=> tms.user_id, 0, 1)) * 1.0000 / COUNT(*) AS unequal_user_id_rate
FROM (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, entrance, unique_id, userid AS user_id, ...
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(livestreams) AS livestream_info
    WHERE grass_date = date'${grass_date}'
      AND grass_region in (${grass_region})
) old
INNER JOIN ubt_day_dup tms
    ON old.unique_id = tms.unique_id
   AND old.grass_date = tms.grass_date
   AND old.entrance = tms.entrance
   AND old.grass_region = tms.grass_region
GROUP BY old.grass_region, old.grass_date, old.entrance,
    CASE WHEN old.entrance = 27 THEN 'LIVE STREAM DISCOVERY' ... END
```

### Snippet 2: TMS vs UBT Item 维度差异对比

```sql
WITH ubt_day_dup AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN entrance = 1 THEN 'GLOBAL SEARCH'
             WHEN entrance = 4 THEN 'YMAL PDP'
             ...
        END AS scence
    FROM (
        SELECT *,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, sequence_id ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC) rn
        FROM dev_mp_paidads.dwd_tracking_tms_request_event_hi__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_date = date '${grass_date}'
          AND grass_region in (${grass_region})
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE temp_tms_old_tracking_item_metrics_dashboard_di PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT
    old.ads_operation, old.entrance,
    CASE WHEN old.entrance = 1 THEN 'GLOBAL SEARCH' ... END AS scence,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old.ads_id <=> tms.ads_id, 0, 1)) AS unequal_ads_id_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old.ads_id <=> tms.ads_id, 0, 1)) * 1.0000 / COUNT(*) AS unequal_ads_id_rate
    -- ... 对所有字段逐个对比
FROM old_tracking_item_table old
INNER JOIN ubt_day_dup tms
    ON old.unique_id = tms.unique_id
   AND old.grass_date = tms.grass_date
GROUP BY old.grass_region, old.grass_date, old.ads_operation, old.entrance, scence
```

### Snippet 3: TMS 与旧版按广告维度 FULL JOIN 对比

```sql
SELECT
    t1.operation AS operation_new, t1.entrance AS entrance_new,
    t2.operation AS operation_old, t2.ads_entrance AS entrance_old,
    COUNT(*) AS num,
    SUM(IF(t1.unique_id != t2.unique_id, 1, 0)) AS unique_id_not_equal,
    SUM(IF(t1.unique_id != t2.unique_id, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS rate
FROM (
    SELECT entrance, unique_id, item_id, ads_id, request_id, placement, pricing_type, user_id,
        CASE WHEN operation = 'impression' THEN 1 WHEN operation = 'click' THEN 2 END AS operation
    FROM dev_mp_paidads.dwd_tracking_tms_request_event_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date '2025-04-20'
      AND grass_region = 'SG'
      AND app_version >= '3.45.0'
      AND rn_version >= '6.54.0'
      AND entrance in ('4')
    GROUP BY entrance, unique_id, operation, item_id, ads_id, request_id, placement, pricing_type, user_id
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT unique_id, ads_id, ads_request_id, ads_placement, ads_entrance, pricing_type, item_id,
        operation, user_id AS user_id_old
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date'2025-04-20'
      AND ads_entrance in ('4')
      AND grass_region = 'SG'
      AND app_ver >= '34500'
      AND rn_ver >= '6.54.0'
      AND operation in(1,2)
    GROUP BY unique_id, ads_id, ads_request_id, ads_placement, ads_entrance, pricing_type, item_id, operation, user_id
) t2
    ON t1.ads_id = t2.ads_id
   AND t1.request_id = t2.ads_request_id
   AND t1.placement = t2.ads_placement
   AND t1.entrance = t2.ads_entrance
```

### Snippet 6: App/Rn 版本格式化

```sql
-- app_version 格式化（去点后比较）
IF(app_version REGEXP '\\.',
   REGEXP_REPLACE(app_version, '\\.', ''),
   app_version) AS app_version_format

-- rn_version 格式化（零填充后比较）
CASE WHEN rn_version REGEXP '\\.'
    THEN CAST(
        CONCAT(
            LPAD(SPLIT(rn_version, '\\.')[0], 3, '0'),
            LPAD(SPLIT(rn_version, '\\.')[1], 3, '0'),
            LPAD(SPLIT(rn_version, '\\.')[2], 3, '0')
        ) AS BIGINT
    )
    ELSE rn_version
END AS rn_version_format
```

### 去重策略

该表通过 `row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, sequence_id ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC)` 去重。下游使用时也需要按天去重（同一个 unique_id 客户端可能延迟上报到不同天），标准写法：

```sql
SELECT *,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, sequence_id ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC) AS rn
FROM dev_mp_paidads.dwd_tracking_tms_request_event_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region IN (${grass_region})

-- 后续 WHERE rn = 1
```
